nodes.description: Public view function verifyTransfer(address,address,uint256) that returns true unless the hardcoded from/to address pair matches, enforcing a hardcoded transfer restriction.
Address parameter _from, the source address checked against a hardcoded address literal.
Address parameter _to, the destination address checked against a hardcoded address literal inside the nested branch.
Unsigned integer parameter _amount; declared but never used in the function body.

Nested equality checks of _from and _to against hardcoded address literals (0x89EB...3252 and 0x63A6...27e8) that silently block transfers for one specific address pair, an immutable and unauditable access-control rule.

edges.reason: Parameter _from is consumed by verifyTransfer as part of its evaluation.
Parameter _to is consumed by verifyTransfer as part of its evaluation.
Parameter _amount is passed into verifyTransfer, though it is never read in the body.
_from is compared with a hardcoded address to gate the transfer, making the caller-supplied address drive an immutable access-control decision.
_to is compared with a hardcoded address in the nested branch, so the supplied destination drives the hardcoded transfer restriction.
verifyTransfer branches on the hardcoded address comparisons, which control the returned authorisation result.
